# historia-gerudo-rezagado, B: marks the cutscene played here at once (A's start is then ignored: 'is set here'), reads
# the steps, only watches while A plays it, and reads the steps again at the end (the target or later).
# Written by tools/harness/historias.py: change its table and run it again, do not edit by hand.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! switches LICHII_COOP_STORY=1
#! timeout 500
#! expect B coop: test flag HavePlayedEvent\.Meet_FourCarpenter_ClearEvent \(0x[0-9a-f]{8}\) = 1 within after..flagged
#! expect B coop: story: STORY_EVENT start received from P\d \('Meet_FourCarpenter_ClearEvent' in GerudoFortress_Adult\): ignored, HavePlayedEvent\.Meet_FourCarpenter_ClearEvent is set here within flagged..end
#! never B coop: story: STORY_EVENT start received from P\d \('Meet_FourCarpenter_ClearEvent' in GerudoFortress_Adult\): starting
#! never B coop: story: event running 'Meet_FourCarpenter_ClearEvent' as P\d asked
#! expect B coop: story: Step_SageOfSpirit \S+ -> Step02 within asked..end
#! expect B coop: test enum Step_SageOfSpirit \(0x[0-9a-f]{8}\): find_type -?\d+, value (Step02|Step03|Step04|Step05|Step05_01|Step05_02|Step05_03|Step06|Step07|Step07_pre00|Step07_00|Step08|Step08_01|Step09|Step09_01|Step10|Complete) \(0x within played..end
mark start
warp GerudoFortress_Adult GerudoFortress_FromGerudoValley
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark after
flag HavePlayedEvent.Meet_FourCarpenter_ClearEvent 1
wait 30
flag HavePlayedEvent.Meet_FourCarpenter_ClearEvent 1   # twice: a queued write may miss the frame the game applies
mark flagged
enum Step_SageOfSpirit
wait 570
mark asked
wait 8550       # only watches while A plays it
mark played
enum Step_SageOfSpirit
wait 600
mark end
